_comment: Reviewed mapping from Studyinfo field-of-education codes (national classification, ISCED-F based) to the Pathway AI taxonomy. Each entry was added only after the code and its official English label were seen in a real API response (labels below are verbatim). A code that is not listed yields no academic field; never add one from a program name. Known unmapped: 0811 (agriculture), which the taxonomy has no field for.
